category_title: Adolescents with challenging behaviors and academic failure in specialized training programs
scenario_title: Initial brainstorming and expression for graffiti mural project
minimal_context: The student is asked to join a group to brainstorm ideas and share personal feelings for their first graffiti mural project.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: For our first graffiti mural, I want you to get into your groups and brainstorm. I'd like you to speak about what you have in your soul and share your inner feelings and emotions with the group to plan the wall.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not working in a group for this. And I'm not talking about what's in my 'soul'. That's weird.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to sit with your group and exteriorize your feelings. What are some things you are angry or passionate about?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't have any feelings to show you. I'm always failing at this school stuff anyway, so I don't know why you expect me to have good ideas.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone has something to contribute. Please just join the group and tell them one emotion you want to put on the wall.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up and pushes chair away) I said I'm not doing it! I'm not sitting in that group talking about my feelings. I'm out of here.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: For our first graffiti mural, I want you to get into your groups and brainstorm. I'd like you to speak about what you have in your soul and share your inner feelings and emotions with the group to plan the wall.

STUDENT: I'm not working in a group for this. And I'm not talking about what's in my 'soul'. That's weird.

TUTOR: Just try to sit with your group and exteriorize your feelings. What are some things you are angry or passionate about?

STUDENT: I don't have any feelings to show you. I'm always failing at this school stuff anyway, so I don't know why you expect me to have good ideas.

TUTOR: Everyone has something to contribute. Please just join the group and tell them one emotion you want to put on the wall.

STUDENT: (Stands up and pushes chair away) I said I'm not doing it! I'm not sitting in that group talking about my feelings. I'm out of here.

task.content: Presenting the project and asking students to speak or show what they had in their soul, exteriorise feelings, and think about the issues and the information that they wanted for their murals, their ideas, feelings, emotions, anger and so on.
task.learning_goal: To make students think their relationship with what surrounds them going from the general 'World' for the particular 'others' to the achievement of two murals.

context.social_setting: Group work on the first wall, class as a space for sharing opinions and ideas
context.time_context: In the beginning of the programme

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When presenting the project and asking them to speak or show what they had in their soul
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Refused to work in a group, conversation, disturbs, walks out of class, modifies the activity, uncooperative
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: A kind of fear of what we asked them for, too difficult to get exteriorised feelings
